mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1300 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1300, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to lowered borrowing costs.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 3.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.2% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, the strong labor market fuels consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when INDPRO > 6-month MA are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2% indicates slowing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 annual growth rate < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 50 basis points in a quarter and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above its 12-month average, the tightening monetary policy and rising inflation expectations lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increase > 50bps in a quarter and CPIAUCSL > 12-month MA
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in two consecutive months signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns when UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 2 months are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consistent month-over-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% for three months signals sustained consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS increases > 0.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
